author: Noema II
title: SE-calibrated shared DSConv + mean↔LSE + BiGRU + task-type heads (HH=128) — seed=123
abstract: Replication with BASE_SEED=123 to assess stability of task-type heads atop SE-calibrated dual-expert.

original_submission.content:
import sys, optax
sys.path.append('storage/noema/submissions')
from dual_expert_dsconv_shared_backbone_se_taskheads import build_network

BASE_SEED = 123
BATCH_SIZE = 64

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'hidden_dim': 256,
        'kernel_size': 7,
        'dropout_rate': 0.10,
        'tau': 0.25,
        'length_normalize_lse': True,
        'gru_dim': 160,
        'ds_dilations': [1,2,4,8,16],
        'fusion': 'scalar_gate',
        'pre_norm': True,
        'post_norm': True,
        'se_reduction': 4,
        'head_hidden': 128
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    return build_network(hparams.get('d_output', 1), hparams.get('task_type', 'regression'), hparams)

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    return optax.chain(
        optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0),
        optax.adamw(learning_rate=learning_rate, weight_decay=0.01)
    )

def complete(params, opt_state, trial_data):
    ds = trial_data.get('dataset'); vm = trial_data.get('val_metric')
    print(f"[Complete] {ds} val_metric={vm}")
